title: Verification system: cost, topology, and evidence policy
description:
Maintenance program derived from the merged audit at
docs/audits/test-suite-and-verification/2026-09-14-test-suite-and-verification-audit.md
(PR #551, merge commit add173fa; owning audit bead eshyra-3xun, closed).

The audit is repository evidence. Its recommendations are proposals, not
authority by themselves.

TWO OBJECTIVES, deliberately separate:

1. Fix the concrete verification-topology problem (execution path).
2. Stop review/disposition failures from regenerating unnecessary
   implementation and proof surface (policy path).

This is explicitly NOT a generic "test cleanup" and carries no test-count
target.

WAVE 1 ONLY. Four children are materialized now:

  Execution path: T1 (Buffer assertion), T2 (worker cap + correct
                  process-tree memory measurement)
  Policy path:    T5 (permanent-evidence policy), T6 (observation ->
                  disposition -> finding gate)

The two paths are genuinely parallel and have very different blast radii, so
they ship as separate PRs.

The remaining audit tasks (T3, T4, T7-T13) are deliberately NOT materialized
yet. Several depend on what wave-1 measurement and policy changes reveal, and
T7 overlaps the already-open eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8. Remeasure the suite after
wave 1 lands, then reassess.

EXISTING BEADS TO AMEND, NOT DUPLICATE:
- eshyra-da8d, eshyra-5g3d: audit supplies the verified cause both lack;
  re-examine after T2 makes them deterministic.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.15: Phase 4 exit dispositions for discovery scaffolding
  (audit T9, not yet materialized).
- eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8: overlaps audit T7; reconcile scope before either starts.
- eshyra-tba9: proposes new proof machinery; re-disposition against T5 before
  building it.
notes: Wave 1 dispatched as two independent PRs: #552 execution path (T1/T2), #553 policy path (T5/T6). Remeasure the suite after both land before materializing any further audit tasks.
